mapper.sql: w.id AS id, w.word AS word, w.normalized_word AS normalizedWord, w.phonetic0 AS phonetic0, w.phonetic1 AS phonetic1, w.trans AS trans, w.sentences AS sentences, w.phrases AS phrases, w.synos AS synos, w.rel_words AS relWords, w.etymology AS etymology, w.primary_pos AS primaryPos, w.primary_definition AS primaryDefinition, w.tags AS tags, w.sequence_no AS sequenceNo, w.difficulty_level AS difficultyLevel, w.exam_frequency AS examFrequency
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM word w WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.enabled = 1 AND w.wordbook_id = #{wordbookId}
AND ( w.word LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR w.normalized_word LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR w.primary_definition LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY w.sequence_no ASC, w.id ASC
SELECT , w.enabled AS enabled FROM word w WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.wordbook_id = #{wordbookId} AND w.id = #{wordId} LIMIT 1
